text: {"label":"Staff Training and Performance Management","definition":"Research on training, supervising, and managing direct-care and human service staff, including pyramidal and remote training, performance feedback, self-monitoring, performance diagnostics, and reactivity in implementer fidelity, in residential and applied settings.","distinct_from_neighbours":"Covers organizational staff training and ongoing performance management broadly, not behavioral skills training specifically, supervision of trainees seeking certification, or skill acquisition procedures for clients."}
